decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric still has its own website page and sits close to the core upholstery offer, so the firm's visible commitment and investment favor keeping it while results can still be read as part of building the market.

The bouclé-effect decorative fabric fits the established range, but its low website presence means little public commitment to defend, and the similar bouclé leno product was already withdrawn, so the risk of dropping it is higher, though not yet decisive.
The double-face wool-blend fabric uses renewable fiber and supports the announced sustainability direction, which gives management a strategic reason to persist despite its modest visibility.

The braided-structure fabric was launched only in 2024 and has its own website page, so the fresh investment and visible commitment strongly favor keeping it, and any weak early results can be attributed to the launch phase.
